Delon Shankar and Melvin Mani have been suspended until further notice
item.description: Rewa FC defender Delon Shankar and Labasa FC midfielder Melvin Mani may not be taking part in the FMF Inter District Championship as they have been suspended. Speaking to fijivillage News Fiji Football Association Chief Executive Officer Mohammed Yusuf says Mani was suspended after he failed to return to camp following the BOG tournament and did not report for national team duties.
item.content:encoded:
Rewa FC defender Delon Shankar and Labasa FC midfielder Melvin Mani may not be taking part in the FMF Inter District Championship as they have been suspended.

Speaking to fijivillage News Fiji Football Association Chief Executive Officer Mohammed Yusuf says Mani was suspended after he failed to return to camp following the BOG tournament and did not report for national team duties.

Yusuf says Shankar was released from the national team camp to undergo rehabilitation but instead travelled to New Zealand.

He says Shankar is currently in New Zealand and has not been allowed to play.

Yusuf says both players remain suspended indefinitely until the Fiji FA Board makes a decision.

He says the timing of the Board meeting will depend on when the Board can meet, as the IDC will be held next week, and the matter will be discussed if an appeal is lodged.

item.title: All 8 Fijian Drua home matches to be played in Fiji despite cost-cutting speculation
item.description: All eight Swire Shipping Fijian Drua home matches will be played in Fiji despite speculation that cost-cutting measures could affect the team's home fixtures amid uncertainty over the future of Super Rugby Pacific. Drua Chief Executive Officer Jeff Miller told fijivillage News that an expense reduction plan was developed using a matrix to assess the potential impact of each measure on team perform
item.content:encoded:
All eight Swire Shipping Fijian Drua home matches will be played in Fiji despite speculation that cost-cutting measures could affect the team's home fixtures amid uncertainty over the future of Super Rugby Pacific.

Drua Chief Executive Officer Jeff Miller told fijivillage News that an expense reduction plan was developed using a matrix to assess the potential impact of each measure on team performance.

Miller says the measures have had no significant impact on player salaries, staffing or operations.

He says the Drua expect any changes to Super Rugby Pacific to be positive and aimed at strengthening the competition and creating more opportunities.

Miller says the Drua's financial plan has not changed, and they are looking to replace funding previously provided by World Rugby through a number of initiatives aimed at developing new revenue streams and growing the Drua brand internationally.

The Drua will play their first home game against the Highlanders on 13th February.

item.title: Scott Wara joins Delta Tigers for FMF IDC 2026
item.description: Scott Wara has joined Rewa FC for the FMF IDC 2026, adding experience and strengthening Tigers squad ahead of the tournament. Rewa FC says Wara brings valuable experience and quality to the squad as they prepare to challenge for the IDC title.
item.content:encoded:
Scott Wara has joined Rewa FC for the FMF IDC 2026, adding experience and strengthening Tigers squad ahead of the tournament.

Rewa FC says Wara brings valuable experience and quality to the squad as they prepare to challenge for the IDC title.

Rewa has been drawn in Pool A and will open its campaign against Nasinu at 3.30pm next week Tuesday.

The Tigers will face Labasa at 7.30pm on Wednesday before completing their pool campaign against Suva at 7.30pm on Thursday 8th .

The FMF IDC 2026 will be held from 6th to 11th this month.
